run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T04:08:04Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning on otel-demo/frontend-proxy reflects a short, discrete burst of checkout failures, not a frontend-proxy fault. frontend-proxy ingress error ratio was 0.0004-0.0019 through 03:59, jumped to 0.0252-0.0255 in the 5-minute windows ending 04:01:04-04:03:04 and decayed back to 0.0011 by 04:08:04; the alert's reported current value 0.0222 falls inside that burst. All the excess errors are on one path: frontend POST /api/checkout and grpc oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder server span and checkout's client span to oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge each gained exactly 69 errors, and those 69 Charge client-span errors were fast fails (every error in duration buckets <=2.0 ms, while successful Charge spans spread up to 10 s). The burst sits inside a payment Deployment rollout: a new ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 was created at 03:58:26, the old ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 was scaled 1->0 and its only pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 deleted at 03:58:29 (all Normal events), payment Deployment spec generation is 2 while every other otel-demo Deployment is generation 1, and the payment container has no readiness probe. Payment then logged only about 3 charges between 03:58:45 and 04:00:24 before continuous 'Charge request received.'/'Transaction complete.' logging resumed, and the old payment span-metric series stopped incrementing while the new pod's series first appeared at 04:01:30 - i.e. the single-replica payment backend was effectively not serving the checkout traffic during the failure interval. frontend-proxy latency was flat across the same period, so this was an error-rate event, not a saturation event. Payment's own spans never carried an error status and the payment pod shows no crash, OOM, eviction or restart, so the failure is best attributed to payment being unavailable to its caller during the replacement, not to payment returning application errors or to a pod failure. Why the payment Deployment was updated (its generation-2 change) is not visible without change history.

claims.text: frontend-proxy ingress error ratio (increase of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",span_name="ingress",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} over increase of all ingress status codes, 5m) was 0.00072/0.00048/0.00036 at 03:10-03:13, rose to 0.01081 at 04:00:04, 0.02531 at 04:01:04, 0.02551 at 04:02:04, 0.02523 at 04:03:04, 0.01487 at 04:04:04, and was 0.00112 at 04:08:04.

At the alert evaluation time 04:08:04, frontend-proxy span counters per 5m were ingress STATUS_CODE_ERROR 3.33 vs STATUS_CODE_UNSET 2974.44, and per 1h ingress STATUS_CODE_ERROR 83.26 vs STATUS_CODE_UNSET 21275.16 plus router frontend egress STATUS_CODE_ERROR 70.06 vs UNSET 21287.34.

Over the hour ending 04:08:04 the only services with non-trivial STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increases were frontend (POST /api/checkout 70.06, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 70.06, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 70.06, POST 70.06), checkout (oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 43.42, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 43.33) and frontend-proxy (ingress 83.26, router frontend egress 70.06); other series were 0 except small steady flagd EventStream counters on ad 2.04, recommendation 3.05 and fraud-detection 2.04.

The failures are a single burst of 69 calls: the frontend POST /api/checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR counter sat at 87 from 03:37:04 to 03:59:04, became 115 at 04:00:04, 156 at 04:01:04 and stayed 156 through 04:11:04; the frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error counter moved 87 -> 115 -> 156 over the same samples; checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR went 28 at 04:00:00 to 69 at 04:01:00 and stayed 69; checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR went 28 at 03:59:30 to 69 at 04:00:30 and stayed 69.

The failed checkout -> payment Charge calls were immediate failures: for checkout span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR all 49.23 (extrapolated) calls in the 180s ending 04:01:30 are in bucket le="2.0" (and therefore in 4.0, 6.0 ... +Inf), whereas the STATUS_CODE_UNSET calls in the same window are spread across buckets up to le="10000.0".

frontend-proxy ingress latency distribution was flat across the burst: the fraction of ingress spans at le=200 ms stayed 0.84-0.89, at le=1000 ms 0.97-0.98 and at le=2000 ms 0.995-1.0 in every 5-minute window from 03:55 to 04:12.

The payment Deployment was rolled during the failure window: events show Scaled up replica set payment-54499f9786 from 0 to 1 at 03:58:26 and SuccessfulCreate of pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d at 03:58:26, container Created and Started at 03:58:28-03:58:29, and Scaled down replica set payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0 with Stopping container payment and SuccessfulDelete of pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 at 03:58:29. All events are type Normal.

Current pod list shows payment-54499f9786-4r25d (owner payment-54499f9786) started 2026-11-15T03:58:26Z, Phase Running, ready, restart count 0, lastState empty, while every other otel-demo pod started 03:26:13-03:28:08. ReplicaSets show payment-54499f9786 created 03:58:26 owned by Deployment payment with replicas 1/ready 1, and payment-55766d76b9 created 03:26:14 owned by Deployment payment with replicas 0.

The payment Deployment is at generation 2 with strategy RollingUpdate maxSurge 25% / maxUnavailable 25%, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, replicas 1, 1 available/ready/updated; every other otel-demo Deployment is at generation 1. Its container definition has readinessProbe null, livenessProbe null and env FLAGD_HOST=flagd, FLAGD_PORT=8013, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://$(OTEL_COLLECTOR_NAME):4317.

Payment span metrics split across two exported instances: series exported_instance=e6edfbd2-... for span_name=charge climbed to 1100 and then stayed at 1100 for every sample from 03:59:30 through 04:10:00, while series exported_instance=3a48ae99-... first appears at 04:01:30 with value 42 and rises to 333 by 04:10:00.

Payment logs show near-zero charge traffic right after the pod replacement: in [03:58:00, 04:01:00] there were only 67 lines and the newest 60 start at 04:00:24 (so only ~7 lines, about 3 charges, before 04:00:24); in [03:50:00, 04:10:00] the newest 100 of 939 lines, all from 04:08:47 to 04:09:56, are alternating 'Charge request received.' and 'Transaction complete.' with no failures.

Payment's own span counters carry no error status: over the hour ending 04:08:04, service payment span_name charge has STATUS_CODE_UNSET 1056.49 and span_name grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge has STATUS_CODE_UNSET 1056.49, while payment GET, dns.lookup and tcp.connect STATUS_CODE_ERROR are all 0. The payment Service endpoint currently resolves to one address 100.96.5.201:8080.

The flagd-dependent errors in other services are background, not a burst: the ad service span_name flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream STATUS_CODE_ERROR counter rose only 1 -> 2 -> 3 between 03:43:04 and 04:11:04.

Available metric names in [03:45:00,04:08:04] are 63 names and include only traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket as span-derived series; http_server_request_duration_seconds_count, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count and app_payment_transactions_total are not among the names returned for that window.

The Jaeger trace data available does not cover the failure interval: the frontend-proxy search over [03:40:00,04:10:00] returned 20 traces / 390 spans whose newest span data is 03:53:56, and the sampled frontend-proxy ingress and router frontend egress spans carry status tags http.status_code 200/308 only.

Primary cause: the payment Deployment rollout at 03:58:26-03:58:29 removed the only payment replica's pod and the replacement payments did not carry checkout traffic until about 04:00:24 (only ~3 charges logged in between, old payment span series frozen, new series first exported at 04:01:30). During that gap checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge calls failed immediately (all error spans <=2 ms), so oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and frontend POST /api/checkout failed 69 times, which raised frontend-proxy ingress error ratio to ~2.5% and triggered RequestErrorRate.

The sub-2 ms failure mode indicates connection/endpoint-level unavailability of the payment backend rather than slow or timed-out calls or payment-side processing errors (no latency shift on any path: checkout Charge successes reach 10 s but all failures stop at 2 ms, and frontend-proxy ingress quantiles are unchanged). Because the payment container has no readiness probe, Kubernetes considered the replacement pod ready as soon as the container started, which is consistent with a short window in which the endpoint set was not actually serving.

Secondary contributor to the alert staying active: frontend-proxy has a non-zero background ingress error ratio (0.00036-0.00187 in the 5-minute samples from 03:10 to 03:59, and 0.00106-0.00144 after 04:06), so a rule that fires when the error rate is above 0 will also be satisfied outside the burst; the rule's actual expression and 'for' duration could not be read.

Rejected: a payment container crash, OOMKill or eviction caused the outage. The payment pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d is Running, ready, restartCount 0, lastState empty, started 03:58:26, and the only payment-related events in the window are Normal Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started plus rollout SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete and ScalingReplicaSet - no Evicted, OOMKilling, BackOff, Failed or Unhealthy event appears.

Rejected: frontend-proxy itself is the failing component. Its errors are confined to the ingress/egress spans of the checkout path that also errored in frontend and checkout, its request latency distribution is unchanged through the burst, and its ingress STATUS_CODE_UNSET count (~21275/h) shows it kept serving normally.

Rejected as the driver of this burst: flagd/feature-flag evaluation errors in ad, recommendation and fraud-detection. Their totals are single-digit per hour and ad's counter rises only 1->3 over 28 minutes, not a burst aligned with the 03:59-04:01 checkout failures.

Give payment (and the other single-replica otel-demo Deployments) a real readinessProbe and a rollout setting that keeps a serving endpoint available, so replacing the only replica cannot create a window in which callers fail fast; verify whether maxSurge 25% with replicas=1 actually created the surge pod before the old one was deleted.

Find out why the payment Deployment spec changed (generation 2) at 03:58:26; the change history integration is not available in this run, so whether this was an image change, config change or manual rollout is unverified, and a config-only change would keep the same image digest.

Review the RequestErrorRate threshold: frontend-proxy carries a continuous background error ratio of roughly 0.0004-0.0019, so a condition of 'above 0' on this service is expected to keep firing outside real incidents; consider a threshold or longer evaluation window based on the actual rule expression.

gaps: Jaeger holds no traces for the failure interval: the newest span data returned for frontend-proxy is 03:53:56 (view 962d18b4-5e7e-4ec8-81c2-2a123d3efc97-t1:9cc0d5e5-630e-4d28-8a15-ce7c15aa0545 is incomplete and truncated), so the exact gRPC status code and error message of the 69 failed oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge calls and any complete call chain for a failed checkout are unknown.

The alerting rule RequestErrorRate is not present in this Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules returned no rule groups (views fdb838e8-fe1e-4d59-91bb-45d2c1fc8bd5-t0:b49de660-9aca-47c1-8537-5e3b1d0d3736 and 23498948-50f7-4d2c-956d-fd2d1454a303-t1:6dbaedb0-f569-4903-b0c6-f6fc154309b5 are no_data), so its exact expression, window and 'for' duration are unknown; the match of the 0.0222 current value to the burst is inferred from the computed ingress ratio.

Filtered payment log searches for fail/error/declin/invalid/warn/exception in [03:50:00,04:12:00] returned no matching lines (view e88e648a-241e-4dad-9a3c-d84be4571f91-t0:623b1932-8a3f-4d08-8e0c-3e433588bddc is no_data), which is a limit of the search, not proof of absence; payment-side error text remains unknown.

No trace matched the tag filters tried for the failure interval (views 3d660858-1ac3-4097-a930-8c96f82318a4-t0:9d5e6e74-4e1f-47a6-8be1-834d6584faac, 8709331b-566b-44cf-a44c-d9f205c167dc-t2:a759b70e-e07b-403f-a7b1-c623d26286cf, 962d18b4-5e7e-4ec8-81c2-2a123d3efc97-t0:9124dd40-f158-4d74-8b96-45af866e448f, ee8bf5cb-e5d1-4dd1-b453-fab668f8c297-t1:739ce260-ce2f-41ab-bfab-0a28f407f59e and 3d660858-1ac3-4097-a930-8c96f82318a4-t1:8aa4180b-5dfb-40d5-a369-563e4ffd7ca6), so span-level error attributes for the burst are unknown.
The reason for the payment Deployment's spec change (generation 2) is unknown because the change_history integration is not available in this run.

The payment log window [03:58:00,04:12:00] was only partially read (view 299e2eba-a4a2-463a-825f-6d806ae54abd-t0:4ddd2cae-dec8-422a-b741-e7fdb00abceb is incomplete, newest 100 of 729 lines; view 35d83d37-71df-4547-9ad3-e6f0e51967c2-t0:4026ab09-b753-40e6-a88b-b7c18f32d344 is incomplete, newest 60 of 67 lines), so the exact first served charge after the rollout and any lines between 03:58:45 and 04:00:24 are only partially observed.
next_steps: Confirm on the cluster whether the payment rollout left zero ready endpoints (inspect Deployment conditions/ReplicaSet history and, if available, rollout history or audit logs for the generation-2 change).
Retrieve a failed checkout trace from a trace backend whose retention covers 03:59-04:01 to record the exact gRPC status/message of the failed oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge calls.
Add a readinessProbe to the payment container and re-test a single-replica rollout to confirm no endpoint gap is created.
Load the RequestErrorRate alerting rule to confirm threshold/window against the observed 0.0004-0.0019 background error ratio.
